title: Opt-in 3D WCS LWPOLYLINE vertices from native OCS
authority: Autodesk DXF LWPOLYLINE (https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2024/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-748FC305-F3F2-4F74-825A-61F04D757A50.htm): points in OCS, group 38 elevation, group 210 extrusion.

Autodesk arbitrary-axis algorithm (https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2015/ENU/AutoCAD-DXF/files/GUID-E19E5B42-0CC7-4EBA-B29F-5E1D595149EE.htm): the strict 1/64 test applies to both X and Y components.
problem: The historical ext=true LWPOLYLINE callback transforms each point to WCS and then retains only its X and Y, leaving one unchanged elevation. For a tilted frame the WCS Z varies by vertex, so 3D positions cannot be recovered from this projected callback. LibreCAD expects that legacy 2D projection and skips non-axial frames; altering callback behavior would change its contract.
change: New optional DRW_DxfGeometry::lwPolylineVerticesToWcs extracts WCS vertex positions from an untouched native OCS entity, such as one received by DXF read(ext=false). It preserves the source, replaces the output only on success, and leaves the existing ext=true callbacks unchanged. Zero/nonfinite normals, nonfinite elevation/XY, null vertices, wrong tag, nonfinite results and normals/bases with lost or subnormal components fail without modifying output.
limits: Callers must establish the untouched native OCS precondition: the entity cannot identify a prior legacy applyExtrusion call. The vector represents vertex positions only; it does not transform or tessellate bulges, widths, thickness, closure or curves. Conversion uses ordinary binary64 arithmetic and conservatively rejects extreme normals with lost/subnormal direction or basis components. This does not fix prior ext=true 2D projections, establish native CAD rendering or qualify arbitrary full-source reads.
physical_source: The ODA AC1027 DXF recorded in docs/research/p6-ac1021-lwpolyline-footer-2026-11-04.json has SHA fd2fdcf79e3d1e64aa3915d5ac3836d56bac0720a78950dbae7be7b7231eac32. ezdxf 1.4.5 independently observes native XY [(0,0),(5,0),(5,3)], elevation 2 and normal (0,1,0), with WCS points [(0,2,0),(-5,2,0),(-5,2,3)]. The in-tree reader emits a matching callback with ext=false and the helper returns the same points, but the overall read subsequently returns false. This is selected-callback evidence only, not a successful full-file read.
tests: ctest --test-dir /private/tmp/lwpoly-ocs-review/build -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_lwpoly_wcs_vertices$ --output-on-failure: 1/1. Controls cover native DXF read, unchanged legacy ext=true projected XY, +Z/-Z/+Y, nonunit and tiny axial normal, (1,1,1), independent 1/64 X and Y boundary values, bulge/width source preservation, nonfinite/zero normals, null vertices, invalid XY/tag/elevation and overflow, underflowed or subnormal normalized direction and axis products, unchanged output on refusal and corrected retry.
integrated_validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_lwpoly_wcs_vertices_tests -j 4; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R ^libdxfrw_dxf_lwpoly_wcs_vertices$ --output-on-failure: 1/1 passed.
